summary-sea-ice: On 31 August 1984, sea ice covered about 7.1 million square kilometres of the Arctic. On 31 August 2026, it covered about 4.2 million. That is 41 percent less ice, measured from these two satellite frames. What you just heard thin out is that loss.
summary-air-temp: In August 1980, the area-weighted mean air temperature of these frames was 16.1 degrees Celsius. In August 2026, it was 17.0 degrees. A difference of 0.9 degrees warmer, for the whole planet, in one month of the year.
